notes: Single-storey tan villa (~15x13 m) with a low HIPPED roof, center-right of frame, heavily occluded by a low-poly citrus tree and two cypress trees. Warm tan ashlar walls (#a8846a sunlit, shaded ~#845f4c); hipped roof surface a muted warm brown-tan (#8f6d5c) with a cream eave/fascia (#c9b79a). Front (street) facade openings are largely hidden behind the citrus tree, so a modest door + two windows are placed at plausible positions (glass/frame tones borrowed from the neighbouring white block's clearly-visible windows -- #45505f glass, #ece9e0 white frames). Frontage: low sandstone-block compound wall (#c0aa85 blocks, lighter mortar) fronting a terracotta brick-paved plaza/sidewalk (#a86a5a, dark joints), red-and-white kerb (not encodable) and grey asphalt road (#666874) to the right; scattered tree/planter greenery gives the verge greens. No gates clearly visible so none encoded. Colours pixel-sampled from the ref 2026-07-04.
